description: A FastAPI application defining an endpoint to update an item with data received in the request body, demonstrating the use of Pydantic models and the Annotated type for request body extraction.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: A Pydantic model representing an item with fields for name, description, price, and tax.

methods.name: update_item(item_id: int, item: Annotated[Item, Body(embed=True)])
methods.description: An asynchronous endpoint function to handle PUT requests to update an item, receiving path parameter 'item_id' and a request body 'item'.

ctags.name: update_item
ctags.pattern: /^async def update_item(item_id: int, item: Annotated[Item, Body(embed=True)]):$/
